entries.wants: where an archived chat is put back from: the Workspace page of `/settings` puts it back
entries.where: clause appended after a semicolon to a line about archiving a chat, lower-case start, no full stop; keep `/settings` in backticks out, write it as /settings
entries.text: the Workspace page of /settings puts it back

entries.wants: what a chat's title is for: it is what the chat is listed by
entries.where: quiet hint beside the one field of the rename form, lower-case start, no full stop
entries.text: what the chat is listed by

entries.wants: what pressing Done on the rename form does: renames the chat
entries.where: quiet hint beside the Done button of a form, lower-case start, no full stop

entries.wants: title of the form that renames a chat
entries.where: sheet title in the terminal interface, sentence case, no full stop

entries.wants: a chat is listed by its title, which is the first line said in it until it is given another
entries.where: one sentence under the title of the rename form
entries.text: A chat is listed by its title, which is the first line said in it until it is given another.

entries.wants: refusal: a chat's title cannot be empty
entries.where: error line under a form, one short sentence
entries.text: A chat's title cannot be empty.

entries.wants: what the Cancel button of the delete question does: keeps the chat
entries.where: quiet hint beside a button, lower-case start, no full stop

entries.wants: what the Delete button of the delete question does: deletes the chat for good
entries.where: quiet hint beside a button, lower-case start, no full stop

entries.wants: title of the list of earlier chats of this folder, one of which is picked to carry on
entries.where: sheet title in the terminal interface, sentence case, no full stop

entries.wants: the chats of this folder, newest first; the one picked is carried on
entries.where: one sentence under the title of the list of chats to resume
entries.text: The chats of this folder, newest first; the one picked is carried on.

entries.wants: what the Rename row of a chat's menu does: gives the chat another title
entries.where: quiet line beside a menu row, lower-case start, no full stop

entries.wants: what the Fork row of a chat's menu does: makes a new chat that goes on from this one, and goes to it
entries.where: quiet line beside a menu row, lower-case start, no full stop
entries.text: makes a new chat that goes on from this one, and goes to it

entries.wants: what the Archive row of a chat's menu does: takes the chat out of this list
entries.where: quiet line beside a menu row, lower-case start, no full stop
entries.text: takes the chat out of this list

entries.wants: what the Upload row of a chat's menu does: backs the chat up to its backup targets, or to the default ones
entries.where: quiet line beside a menu row, lower-case start, no full stop
entries.text: backs the chat up to its backup targets, or to the default ones

entries.wants: what the Delete row of a chat's menu does: removes the chat for good, after asking
entries.where: quiet line beside a menu row, lower-case start, no full stop
entries.text: removes the chat for good, after asking

entries.wants: the chat was renamed and is now called {name}
entries.where: one quiet line under a list after an action, starts with the past participle like the page's `Renamed`, no full stop

entries.wants: the chat {name} was archived
entries.where: one quiet line under a list after an action, starts with the past participle like the page's `Archived`, no full stop

entries.wants: the chat is being backed up to the backup targets {targets}
entries.where: one quiet line under a list after an action, no full stop

entries.wants: the chat {name} was deleted
entries.where: one quiet line under a list after an action, starts with the past participle like the page's `Deleted`, no full stop

entries.wants: the chats of this folder that were archived, newest first; the one picked is put back among the others, where /resume in a chat lists it
entries.where: one or two sentences under the title of the list of archived chats
entries.text: The chats of this folder that were archived, newest first. The one picked is put back among the others, where /resume in a chat lists it.

entries.wants: the archived chats are being read
entries.where: placeholder line of a list while it loads, in the manner of the page's `Reading the list…`, ends with an ellipsis character

entries.wants: no chat of this folder is archived
entries.where: empty-state line of a list, one short sentence in the manner of the page's `No archived chats.`

entries.wants: the archived chat {name} was put back among the others
entries.where: one quiet line under a list after an action, no full stop

entries.wants: a `$` name that is both a skill and a flow: it runs {picked}, and /flow {name} starts the flow
entries.where: quiet description beside a completion offered under the prompt, lower-case start, no full stop, one line
entries.text: skill and flow: runs {picked}; /flow {name} starts the flow

entries.wants: the skill (as the object of `runs`)
entries.where: two words filling {picked} in `skill and flow: runs {picked}`, lower case

entries.wants: the flow (as the object of `runs`)
entries.where: two words filling {picked} in `skill and flow: runs {picked}`, lower case

entries.wants: a `$` name that is a skill, followed by what the skill says it does: skill · {about}
entries.where: quiet description beside a completion, lower case `skill`, a middle dot, then {about}

entries.wants: a `$` name is a skill
entries.where: one lower-case word beside a completion

entries.wants: a `$` name is a flow
entries.where: one lower-case word beside a completion
